title: edm-stop-gate exits 2 without ever reading stop_hook_active, so a routine blocking anomaly or any stop-event block rule makes the session unable to terminate
Rule file path and rule name/action/message are interpolated into a tab/newline-delimited record stream, letting a crafted filename forge a block verdict without an enabled block rule
try/catch covers only fromjson, so one malformed rule file aborts the whole jq pass and silently disables every other rule, contradicting the documented isolation contract
Hookify rule-author message is folded verbatim into permissionDecisionReason with no provenance framing, giving a repository a prompt-injection channel into the model
regex_match runs an untrusted Oniguruma pattern with no time bound; the 64 KiB input cap does not bound catastrophic backtracking and the header claims it does
Setup-error and list emissions bypass EDMV4-T52's sanitizer, writing raw rule-author bytes (ESC sequences) to stderr and echoing a name that can be read as an echo option
Unquoted glob_list=($globs) applies pathname expansion to EDM_GATEGUARD_EXEMPT_GLOBS, silently converting exemption patterns into literal paths and breaking the SRD/test/build exemptions
edm-bash-gate and edm-stop-gate ship no kill switch, unlike edm-gateguard's documented EDM_GATEGUARD/EDM_GATEGUARD_DISABLED pair, leaving no escape hatch for a gate on the Bash matcher
CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR accepted on a bare -d test with no git-toplevel containment check, re-introducing the CA-500 pattern edm-state hardened; the help text's parity claim is stale
Predictable $$-suffixed temp filenames written with a symlink-following redirect in a state directory that env vars can relocate to shared /tmp; family standard is mktemp
A NUL byte inside a rule file desynchronizes split("\u0000") from $ARGS.positional, pairing every later rule's content with the wrong file path
Unpaired BSD-only stat -f '%N %z %m' in the AC9 no-write snapshot degrades to filesystem status on Linux; both divergence sweeps exclude /tests/ so it escapes T51 and T61 AC11
Unguarded perl -pe in the smoke suite that is the plugin's only enforcement mechanism, on the untested Linux platform where perl may be absent
Unquoted for-loop over ls output makes the EDMV4-T04 citation-orphan check scan zero files and report clean whenever the plugin root path contains whitespace
gg_record_denial swallows every write failure silently, so the EDM_GATEGUARD_MAX_DENIALS budget can go permanently inert with no operator-visible signal
flock on fd 200 is inside the 10+ band but the CA-415 comment documents the choice and bash 3.2 offers no dynamic-fd idiom
md5sum last-resort fallback in hash_file is an artifact-drift checksum, never a security primitive, so the weak-algorithm rule does not bind
grep -qP is a documented, guarded PCRE-availability probe with a BRE fallback, asserted by name in wave7-smoke.sh
stat -c %Y with a stat -f %m fallback is the sanctioned portable pair; verified as the only such pair in non-test bin/
Header cites a .gitlab-ci.yml lint job that no longer exists anywhere in the repository; the named enforcement control is absent but the duplication it guarded is inert
Interpreter-dependent echo of $ARGUMENTS is quoted and the result is immediately clamped to [A-Za-z0-9_-], so nothing unsafe survives
Predictable shared-tmp lock-timeout marker is already hardened by G17/CA-305 (atomic mkdir) and G13/CA-347 (probe gated on exit 99)
A symlinked .claude/edm-hookify directory silently yields zero rules; fails in the safe direction (no enforcement rather than wrong enforcement)
EDM_EVAL_MAX_BUDGET_USD is documented as deliberately unvalidated, so a non-numeric spend ceiling fails open; outside this initiative's diff and already recorded
Categories genuinely inapplicable to this target: systemd sandboxing, container/cloud misconfig, CORS, SQL injection, SSRF, credential/MCP-token handling, TLS, and dependency pinning/update signing
Relays edm-lint-artifacts output containing repository file content into a PreToolUse refusal the model reads; same class as the gateguard finding but pre-existing (CA-436)
